subject: curves-08-rebuild-once
observed: SwAgent.Smoke compiled and ran the exact installed sidecar with Kit 0.4.0. Recipe SHA-256 c40b89561d3719259d10e3e6477111a208226f3dc1224b1d1fee8cea23b60ca1. The recipe changed the extrusion from 20 mm to 25 mm inside Kit.Batch, saved after the checked rebuild, and reopened the result with a 25 mm extrusion and approximately 139895.797 mm³ volume. Restore recovered the original bytes and 20 mm depth.
